briefs.mission: Develop a low-speed electric mobility product for mixed local logistics and assisted mobility use, and manufacture reusable production tooling for the next product generation.
briefs.unresolved_tradeoff: capital spent on today's product competes with capital spent on reusable mechanical, electronics and battery production operators

briefs.mission: Respond to the registered post-trial demand shift while using the exact operator bundle manufactured in generation 0; produce a more accessible, repairable and weather-tolerant successor product and improve the production cell again.
briefs.unresolved_tradeoff: do not merely maximize one visible attribute; preserve physical safety and successor-production value
